decisions.reason: Moving the panel power-button connector to the main board and tapping PWRON on J_PWR_SIG pin 4 does not alter the native USB data route on pins 5 and 6, the USB-C programming role, or standalone programming support.
The panel power-button connector relocation does not change the standalone USB regulator, activation condition, powered rail, Schottky-diode source selection, or normal-operation power source.
